technique_name: Write a paragraph comparing the economy of two countries
description: Germany and France have both seen significant growth in their economies in recent years. While Germany has the world’s third-largest GDP, France has a GDP of only half that size. Despite this, France has the sixth-largest economy in Europe, and its GDP per capita ranks higher than Germany’s. Furthermore, the French economy has seen its share of growth, with the service and industrial sectors leading the way.
